title: Parallax Fantasy Map
description: A detailed fantasy map illustration shows a winding river flowing from volcanic badlands with glowing lava in the southwest, through golden agricultural fields and a stone bridge, past a windmill and forests, toward a large lake with a floating island connected by chains in the north. A compass rose sits in the bottom left corner while the word PARALLAX appears in the bottom right.
prompt: Detailed fantasy map artwork showing a continuous landscape divided into distinct biomes: a volcanic region with flowing lava and dark smoke in the southwest, transitioning into fertile green and golden agricultural fields with a stone arch bridge over a wide blue river, a windmill, dense forests, a mysterious dark lake with circular ripples, and a large floating island chained to the ground in the northern waters, with a compass rose in the corner and the word PARALLAX in the bottom right, painted in a storybook fantasy style
